title: Differential expression of cytokines in breast cancer patients receiving different chemotherapies: implications for cognitive impairment research
notes: N=54 BC patients: 28 doxorubicin+cyclophosphamide, 26 docetaxel+cyclophosphamide. Differential cytokine changes by regimen. IL-6, IL-8, MCP-1 increased post-chemo in AC group.
